CHAPTER 8 - MUNICIPAL IRRIGATION SYSTEM REGULATIONS
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","Title":"CHAPTER 8 - MUNICIPAL IRRIGATION SYSTEM REGULATIONS","Content":"

\n SECTION:\n


","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":763,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-1: - CITY AUTHORITY:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-1CIAU","Title":"7-8-1: - CITY AUTHORITY:","Content":"
\n

\n The irrigation system for the supply of the city shall be under the sole and exclusive\n control of the city council, who may from time to time direct the construction and\n extension of such works, placing of mains and service pipes, as the necessity of the\n city may require. The irrigation system shall be known as \"Kuna Municipal Irrigation\n District\".\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":764,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-2: - APPLICATION FOR SERVICE:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-2APSE","Title":"7-8-2: - APPLICATION FOR SERVICE:","Content":"
\n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n A landowner desiring to obtain an irrigation system connection permit shall file a\n written application, with the city, which information shall be in sufficient detail\n as to adequately inform the city as to the proposed location of the desired irrigation\n system connection and the demand (estimated consumption) to be used by the connection.\n The landowner shall be responsible for all construction costs related to the irrigation\n system connection. Filing of the application with the city does not guarantee that\n a connection or connections are available and will be provided. All applicable fees\n and connection charges shall be paid prior to issuing a building permit.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n If the city engineer and city council determine that the irrigation system is at or\n near capacity, acceptance of applications for irrigation system connections will be\n stopped until such time that the irrigation system has the capacity available to provide\n service to the new connections.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":765,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-3: - ANNUAL IRRIGATION ASSESSMENTS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-3ANIRAS","Title":"7-8-3: - ANNUAL IRRIGATION ASSESSMENTS:","Content":"
\n

\n Annual irrigation assessments are set by city council in compliance with IC tit. 50,\n ch. 18, as per the schedule approved by resolution of the city council. As an alternative\n to the lump sum payment of the annual irrigation assessment, the city council may\n establish a procedure to collect the annual irrigation assessment in equal monthly\n installments, with the number of installments and monthly payment amount set by resolution.\n The irrigation assessment schedule shall be maintained and available to the public\n through the city clerk's office.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":766,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-4: - POOLING OF IRRIGATION WATER RIGHTS AUTHORIZED:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-4POIRWARIAU","Title":"7-8-4: - POOLING OF IRRIGATION WATER RIGHTS AUTHORIZED:","Content":"
\n

\n Except a landowner who makes written demand for delivery of irrigation water in accordance\n with an appurtenant water right on or before March 1 of the applicable year, all landowners\n within the service area of the city's irrigation system are deemed to have consented\n to the pooling of water rights for delivery purposes. Annually, the city shall furnish\n each irrigation district containing lands within the city's irrigation system a certified\n list or map showing all such lands for which water rights have been pooled. Assessments\n for such lands shall be set according to Idaho law.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":767,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-5: - IRRIGATION SYSTEM CONNECTION FEES;
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-5IRSYCOFE","Title":"7-8-5: - IRRIGATION SYSTEM CONNECTION FEES;","Content":"
\n

\n It is hereby established that the total irrigation connection fee to the city irrigation\n system shall consist of a basic fee which is determined by the area included in the\n water right, the size of the service connection and the area to be irrigated, all\n in accordance with a schedule adopted by resolution of Kuna City Council.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":768,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-6: - IRRIGATION SERVICE RE-CONNECTION:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-6IRSENN","Title":"7-8-6: - IRRIGATION SERVICE RE-CONNECTION:","Content":"
\n

\n In the event the irrigation department turns off the irrigation water connection for\n nonpayment of the assessment and/or any fees, the reconnection fee shall be fifteen\n dollars ($15.00), if performed during normal work hours or fifty dollars ($50.00)\n if performed after normal work hours, which shall be paid prior to the account being\n reconnected.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":769,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-7: - IRRIGATION WATER ASSESSMENTS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-7IRWAAS","Title":"7-8-7: - IRRIGATION WATER ASSESSMENTS:","Content":"
\n

\n The operation and maintenance costs for irrigation water within the city shall be\n determined each year by the city council and assessments made according to Idaho law.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":770,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-8: - RIGHT OF ACCESS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-8RIAC","Title":"7-8-8: - RIGHT OF ACCESS:","Content":"
\n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Any landowner who receives Kuna municipal irrigation water, as a condition of receiving\n said water, agrees to provide access upon the landowner's real property to any authorized\n agent of the city to all areas supplied with Kuna irrigation water for the purpose\n of operating valves, making repairs, examining the apparatus and ensuring that the\n municipal irrigation system is used in accordance with regulations applicable to using\n the same.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Any user of the Kuna municipal irrigation system violating any of the rules and regulations\n controlling the irrigation system shall forfeit all fees and payments made and the\n right to use of water from the municipal irrigation system.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":771,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-9: - USERS OUTSIDE CITY LIMITS, PROHIBITED:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-9USOULIPR","Title":"7-8-9: - USERS OUTSIDE CITY LIMITS, PROHIBITED:","Content":"
\n

\n No irrigation water shall be furnished from the city irrigation system to landowners\n outside of the boundaries of the city until state law permits the delivery of irrigation\n water pooled for delivery purposes to such property. In the event state law permits\n such delivery, All landowners outside of the boundaries of the city receiving irrigation\n water from the city irrigation system shall be required to enter into a contract with\n the city council granting to the said city or its agent the right to go upon the premises\n of said irrigation water users at any and all times for the purpose of inspection,\n making repairs or turning off irrigation water, and the said irrigation water users\n shall further agree in said contract to abide by all the rules and regulations governing\n the distribution of irrigation water which are applicable to irrigation water users\n within the city, and to pay for all fees and assessments at such rates and such time\n as the council may determine.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":772,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-10: - MISCELLANEOUS REGULATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-10MIRERE","Title":"7-8-10: - MISCELLANEOUS REGULATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:","Content":"
\n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Stopcock: There shall be attached to each service pipe, at or near the point of access to irrigation\n mains, a stopcock which shall be under the exclusive control of the city.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n No tampering permitted: Any person or entity who individually, by family, servants, employees, successors,\n or assigns uses irrigation water from the irrigation system without first paying therefor\n as provided for in this chapter and, without authority, opens any stop box, valve\n or other fixtures attached to the city's irrigation system, or who in any manner injures,\n defaces or impairs any part or apparatus or appurtenance of the irrigation system\n shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and be subject to a one thousand dollar ($1,000.00)\n fine for each offense.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n C.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Illegally turning on irrigation water: Any person, who, after the irrigation water has been turned off to the property on\n account of nonpayment of assessments and/or fees, or other violation of the rules\n and regulations pertaining to the irrigation system, shall turn on or permit the irrigation\n water to be turned on, or use or permit the irrigation water to be used without authority,\n shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n D.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n City not liable for shortage: The city shall not be liable for damage to any irrigation water user by reason of\n the stoppage, or other interruption of his irrigation water supply, caused by scarcity\n of water, accident to works or mains, alterations, additions, repairs or from other\n unavoidable causes.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n E.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Alternate day irrigating: Irrigation from the Kuna municipal pressurized irrigation system may be scheduled\n to occur on alternate days by order of the city or its agent. If an order is instituted,\n homes with a street address ending with an odd number shall irrigate on odd numbered\n days and homes with a street address with an even number shall irrigate on even numbered\n days.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n F.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Homeowners' associations to be obligated for irrigation fees and assessments on common\n lots and parks: All homeowners' associations using the municipal pressurized irrigation system must\n pay the fees for the irrigating of common lots and parks within the association's\n jurisdiction.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n G.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Wanton wasting of irrigation water or use of irrigation water in a manner to cause\n damage or nuisance to adjoining properties is prohibited. The city or its agent may\n disconnect any service which wastes, causes damage to adjacent property or creates\n a nuisance through its use of irrigation water from the city system.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":773,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-11: - PRESSURE IRRIGATION (PI) SYSTEM EXTENSIONS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-11PRIRPISYEX","Title":"7-8-11: - PRESSURE IRRIGATION (PI) SYSTEM EXTENSIONS:","Content":"
\n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n All proposed extensions and/or oversizing of the city pressure irrigation system to\n serve undeveloped areas within or without the existing city limits shall be recommended\n by the city engineer and approved in advance by the city council on a case by case\n basis. The extension of the pressure irrigation system is a privilege and will only\n be considered when, in the best interests of the city, the extension takes into consideration\n the city's overall master plan for the pressure irrigation system.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Costs for all extensions and/or oversizing, whether within or without the existing\n city limits, shall be the responsibility of the property owner or his agent.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n C.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n All PI system extensions and/or oversizing shall be installed prior to the construction\n of any new streets unless a special use permit is granted by the city. All design\n and construction of any extensions and/or oversizing of the PI system shall comply\n with the official specifications for PI systems and extensions as adopted by the city.\n The plans for all extensions and/or oversizing to the PI system shall be prepared\n and signed by a registered professional engineer as per the licensing requirements\n of the Idaho Code. Three (3) copies of the plans shall be filed with the city for\n their review and approval as required by the Idaho Code. In approving a plan for extension\n and/or oversizing to the PI system, the city reserves the right to impose other requirements\n such as a special permit fee, right-of-way limits, sequence of construction, time\n limits for having existing service disrupted, the filing of a performance bond and\n other similar measures as may be required to protect the public. No work shall commence\n on any such extension and/or oversizing until the project has been approved by the\n city.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n D.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n After the construction of any PI system extension and/or oversizing, it shall be the\n obligation of the owner or his agent to have a registered professional engineer certify\n to the city and to the Idaho Department of Environmental Quality that the said system\n extensions and/or oversizing were installed in accordance with the approved plans\n and specifications on file with the respective agencies. Following certification by\n the registered professional engineer and acceptance by the city, the entire extension\n and/or oversizing of the PI system, including the city PI service lines, shall become\n property of the city and it shall be the city's responsibility to maintain and operate\n the system thereafter.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n E.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n If it is necessary for the city to permit a PI service connection and/or PI service\n line at any time after the extension has been originally accepted by the city, the\n owner or his agent shall be required to pay all applicable PI hookup fees as well\n as the standard permit and inspection fees as may be established by the city for such\n purposes.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":774,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-11-1: - PRESSURE IRRIGATION CONSTRUCTION REIMBURSEMENT POLICY:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-11-1PRIRCOREPO","Title":"7-8-11-1: - PRESSURE IRRIGATION CONSTRUCTION REIMBURSEMENT POLICY:","Content":"
\n

\n The owner or his agent, who has paid for the construction of oversizing or off-site\n extension of the PI system, at the request of the city, may apply to the city for\n reimbursement for eligible costs incurred in the construction. The city council will\n establish and maintain a pressure irrigation construction reimbursement policy by\n adopting a resolution that will establish the method for determination of the appropriate\n reimbursement available. The amount of the reimbursement due will be reimbursed from\n the transmission portion of pressure irrigation main line fees collected by the city.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":775,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-11-2: - CONNECTION PERMITS AND INSPECTIONS:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-11-2COPEIN","Title":"7-8-11-2: - CONNECTION PERMITS AND INSPECTIONS:","Content":"
\n

\n No pressurized irrigation connection shall be allowed until a connection permit application,\n on a form furnished by the city, has been filed and approved by the city or its authorized\n employee, and the applicable hookup fees paid. Such form shall require the applicant\n to notify the city for an inspection of the pressurized connection. If any connection\n is covered prior to the city's inspection, the applicant will be responsible for the\n cost of uncovering the pressurized irrigation line and a fine of one hundred dollars\n ($100.00), which shall be collected prior to inspection.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":776,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-12: - PENALTIES:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-12PE","Title":"7-8-12: - PENALTIES:","Content":"
\n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n It shall be a criminal misdemeanor, punishable by a fine of up to one thousand dollars\n ($1,000.00), to connect to the city's pressurized irrigation system without a permit\n authorized by the city. In addition, the owner of the land upon which the illegal\n connection is located shall be liable for the costs incurred by the city caused by\n such illegal connections including legal costs incurred.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n It shall be a criminal misdemeanor, punishable by a fine of up to one thousand dollars\n ($1,000.00), for any developer to connect properties adjacent to property that they\n are developing to the city's pressurized irrigation system without a permit authorized\n by the city. Each connection extended to an unauthorized property shall be a separate\n offense. In addition, the developer shall be liable for the actual costs incurred\n by the city caused by such illegal connections including any legal costs incurred.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n

","SortDate":null,"Footnotes":null},{"DocType":1,"IsAmended":false,"IsUpdated":false,"CompareStatus":4,"DocOrderId":777,"AmendedBy":[],"UncodifiedOrdinancesAffectingThis":[],"Notes":[],"Drafts":[],"ChunkGroupStartingNodeId":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE","NodeDepth":3,"TitleHtml":"
7-8-13: - SEVERABILITY:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT7PUWAPR_CH8MUIRSYRE_7-8-13SE","Title":"7-8-13: - SEVERABILITY:","Content":"
\n

\n If any clause, sentence, paragraph, section, or any part of this chapter, shall be\n declared and adjudged to be invalid or unconstitutional by a court of competent jurisdiction,\n such invalidity or unconstitutionality shall not affect, invalidate, or nullify the\n remainder of this chapter.\n

\n

\n (Ord. No. 2013-05, § 1, 1-15-2013)\n
